# WhatsApp Templates to Submit for Approval

<!-- Generated by `npm run wa:templates -- markdown`. Edit the flow in
     supabase/functions/_shared/quick-reply-flow.ts, not this file. -->

Only **4 of the 8** quick-reply templates need Meta's approval — the ones that *start* a conversation. The other 4 are only ever sent as an instant reply to a tap, which is inside WhatsApp's 24-hour customer-service window, so they need no approval.

## The fastest, safest route

```bash
export TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=AC…
export TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=…

npm run wa:templates -- create --confirm   # build all 8 in Twilio
npm run wa:templates -- submit --confirm   # send the 4 above to Meta
npm run wa:templates -- status            # check approval
npm run wa:templates -- sql               # SIDs, ready to store
```

This builds each template from the flow definition, so the **button id Meta approves is byte-for-byte the payload the lead board matches on**. Typing them by hand is the one way this feature breaks quietly: an approved button id with a trailing space looks correct in the console and arrives as unrecognised free text.

If you would rather use the console, every field is written out below.

## Templates needing approval

### Re-engage — still looking?

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Template name | `hde_qr_still_looking` |
| Category | **MARKETING** |
| Language | English (`en`) |
| Content type | `twilio/quick-reply` |
| Header / Footer | none |

**Body**

```
Hi {{1}}! Home Decor Enterprises here (authorised Godrej Interio, {{3}}). Are you still looking for {{2}}? Just tap below — no need to call.
```

**Sample values** (Meta requires one per placeholder)

| Placeholder | Sample | Filled at send time with |
|---|---|---|
| `{{1}}` | Rahul | the lead's first name |
| `{{2}}` | a 3-seater fabric sofa | what they liked or asked about |
| `{{3}}` | Dehradun | the showroom city |

**Quick-reply buttons**

| Button text | Button id — must match exactly |
|---|---|
| Yes, still looking | `QR_STILL_LOOKING` |
| Just browsing | `QR_JUST_BROWSING` |
| Already bought | `QR_ALREADY_BOUGHT` |

## On the category choice

Category is not paperwork — it decides throttling. A MARKETING template sent to many recipients gets rate-limited by Meta (Twilio error 63049), which is why this account's Insider notification template was already moved to UTILITY.

| Template | Submitted as | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `hde_qr_still_looking` | MARKETING | Re-opening a dormant enquiry is promotional. No way around it. |
| `hde_qr_keep_enquiry_open` | MARKETING | Same — we are the ones restarting the conversation. |
| `hde_qr_price_feedback` | UTILITY | Follows up a price **the customer asked us for** by tapping “Send price & offers”. |
| `hde_qr_post_visit` | UTILITY | Feedback after a visit the customer made. |

Be aware: Meta can reclassify the two UTILITY ones to MARKETING on review. That does not break anything — the template still works — but those two would then be subject to marketing limits. `npm run wa:templates -- status` shows the category Meta actually assigned.

## Why these should pass review

Meta rejects templates for a short list of reasons. `src/test/quickReplyFlow.test.ts` enforces the mechanical ones on every commit:

| Rejection reason | How these avoid it |
|---|---|
| Body starts or ends with a variable | Tested — none do |
| Two variables next to each other | Tested — none do |
| Missing or unrealistic sample values | Every placeholder has a real sample |
| Body over 1024 characters | Tested — longest is well under |
| More than 3 quick-reply buttons, or labels over 20 characters | Tested |
| Vague or generic content | Each names the business, the product and one clear question |
| Missing business identity | The opening template names Home Decor Enterprises and the Godrej Interio authorisation |
| No way to opt out | “Stop messages” is a button on the recurring templates, and a typed `stop` is always honoured |

## After approval

Store each Content SID (`HX…`) against its step — `npm run wa:templates -- sql`, or paste them in **Admin → Automation Monitor → Quick-reply conversation**. Until a SID is stored, the engine sends nothing for that question and logs `quick_reply_template_missing`.

See `WHATSAPP_QUICK_REPLY_FLOW.md` for what each button does to the lead board.
